author: musho7-dev
subject: Dashboard: publish to GitHub Pages, auto-publish on every push
body:
- New 'publish' command copies the site and data into a clone of
  musho777/gravity-garage-dashboard and pushes it
- After a push is snapshotted, the newest pushed commit becomes the
  published Cars/Maps view and the site is republished automatically
